question:
Monthly expenditure of a family on different heads is shown in the following pie chart. The family earns Rs. 1,08,000 every month.

The money (in Rs.) spent on Misc. Expenses is how much more than that spent on Children Education?

E**xpenditure on different Heads**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f6ec63332bbfa57461207ffaf1345277209337b56db7f303dce566f5b8939b.png] **
solution:
Given:

There is the monthly expenditure of a family on different heads is shown in the following pie chart.

Income of the family = Rs. 108000/month

Calculation:

The total angle of all expenditures = 75° + 60° + 70° + 65° + 50° + 40° = 360°

The difference between Misc. Expenses and spent on Children's Education = 75° - 70° = 5°

So, the amount differences = (5/360) × 108000 = Rs. 1500

**∴ The money (in Rs.) spent on Misc. Expenses are Rs. 1500 more than that spent on Children's Education.**
